title: An old last range that differed from the one above keeps its own rule
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Use the staging site, where the Tiered Pricing release is deployed on top of data from before the release.
  • Before the release is deployed to staging, have a category matrix (matrix A) whose last range has a different markup from the range above (for example 30% then 25%), and another (matrix B) whose last two ranges match (30% and 30%).
  • Use the same client after the deploy.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list.
  3. Click Edit.
  4. Type 35 in Default's second-to-last range.
  5. Click Cancel.
  6. Click Discard Changes.
  7. Open matrix B from the Matrices list.
  8. Click Edit.
  9. Type 35 in Default's second-to-last range.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Matrix A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Matrix A's last two ranges read 30% markup and 25% markup.

Step 3:

  • The grid is in edit.

Step 4:

  • Matrix A's second-to-last range reads 35.
  • Matrix A's last range stays 25: it does not follow the 35.

Step 5:

  • The discard question opens.

Step 6:

  • The grid returns to view.

Step 7:

  • Matrix B's page opens.

Step 8:

  • The grid is in edit.

Step 9:

  • Matrix B's last range changes to 35 with the range above.

AUTOMATION: HOLD - needs a matrix set up on staging before the Tiered Pricing release is deployed there; run on staging after the deploy
